source.original_text: Faithful scoped paraphrase of Chen–Chewi–Lu–Zhang, arXiv:2609.06906v1, Lemma 4.16 proof: under normalized Hessian bounds alpha I <= Hessian U <= I, an admissible reference point satisfies squared gradient norm at most alpha times dimension. The proof selects a critical minimizer p, obtains its reference-point distance from strong monotonicity, bounds the Gibbs position second moment, adds independent Gaussian smoothing of variance eta <= 1, and couples the two phase momenta identically. For q=2, these steps give squared M_kappa transport cost at most 5 kappa d when kappa=1/alpha. This ASTIS component supplies p explicitly and does not prove its existence or the source lemma for every q>=2.

lean.statement: For every finite-dimensional complete real inner-product Borel space E, every potential U:E→ℝ, alpha and eta in NNReal with 0<alpha<=1, U in C², alpha*‖v‖² <= fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ U) x v v <= ‖v‖² for all x,v, every p,xref in E with gradient U p=0 and ‖gradient U xref‖² <= alpha*finrank ℝ E, and eta<=1: let μ=(volume:Measure E).tilted (fun x=>-U x), piEta=gaussianSmoothing μ (Real.sqrt eta); PhaseMetric.phaseWassersteinSq (1/alpha) ((Measure.dirac xref).prod (stdGaussian E)) (piEta.prod (stdGaussian E)) <= ENNReal.ofReal (5*(1/alpha)*finrank ℝ E).

blind_reconstruction.text: Let E be a finite-dimensional complete real inner-product Borel space, U:E→ℝ be C², and alpha,eta be nonnegative reals with 0<alpha<=1 and eta<=1. Assume alpha‖v‖² <= D²U(x)[v,v] <= ‖v‖² for every x,v. Given p and xref with gradient U(p)=0 and ‖gradient U(xref)‖² <= alpha dim_R E, set μ=volume.tilted(-U) and piEta=gaussianSmoothing μ (sqrt eta). Then the squared phase quadratic Kantorovich infimum at parameter 1/alpha between (dirac xref)⊗standardGaussian and piEta⊗standardGaussian is at most ENNReal.ofReal(5 dim_R E/alpha). The theorem assumes p and xref; it does not establish their existence. Eta=0 is permitted. The constant is exactly 5 dim_R E/alpha and has no further eta or U dependence.

import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.SmoothedPicardHMC.PhaseReferenceMoment

/-!
# The smoothed-Gibbs q=2 initialization component of SPHMC Lemma 4.16

This result uses the actual normalized Gibbs law, its Gaussian smoothing and
the same-momentum phase coupling.  The paper chooses a minimizer `p` in the
proof; this interface still supplies that critical point explicitly.  Its
existence and the source's all-q concentration estimate are separate edges.
-/

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory InnerProductSpace
open scoped ENNReal NNReal RealInnerProductSpace

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.SmoothedPicardHMC.InitialGibbsPhaseTransport

open AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.GaussianSmoothing
open AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Analysis

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [CompleteSpace E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]

/-- Under the source's normalized curvature and reference-gradient hypotheses,
the actual initial phase law is at squared `M_κ` transport cost at most `5κd`
from the smoothed Gibbs reference phase law.  This is only the `q = 2`
component of Lemma 4.16, conditional on the proof's critical-point witness. -/
theorem initial_gibbs_phase_transport_q2
    {U : E → ℝ} {α η : ℝ≥0} (hα : 0 < α) (hαone : α ≤ 1)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ 2 U)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ U) x v v ∧
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ U) x v v ≤ ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (p xref : E) (hp : gradient U p = 0)
    (href : ‖gradient U xref‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (α : ℝ) * (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ)) (hη : η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -U x)
    let πη := gaussianSmoothing μ (Real.sqrt η)
    PhaseMetric.phaseWassersteinSq (1 / (α : ℝ))
      ((Measure.dirac xref).prod (stdGaussian E))
      (πη.prod (stdGaussian E)) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (5 * (1 / (α : ℝ)) * (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ)) := by
  classical
  let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -U x)
  let πη := gaussianSmoothing μ (Real.sqrt η)
  have ha : (0 : ℝ) < α := hα
  have haone : (α : ℝ) ≤ 1 := hαone
  have hκ : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (α : ℝ) := (one_le_div ha).2 haone
  have hdim : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E := by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le _
  have hdata := GibbsPositionMoment.gibbs_position_moment
    (β := 1) hα hαone hU
      (fun x v => ⟨(hH x v).1, by simpa using (hH x v).2⟩) p hp
  obtain ⟨hprob, _, _, hpos, _, _, hposBound⟩ := hdata
  change Integrable (fun x : E => ‖x - p‖ ^ 2) μ at hpos
  change (∫ x : E, ‖x - p‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤
    (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) / (α : ℝ) at hposBound
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hprob
  have hsc : StrongConvexOn (Set.univ : Set E) (α : ℝ) U :=
    HessianStrongConvexity.strongConvexOn_univ_of_fderiv2_lower hU
      (fun x v => (hH x v).1)
  have hd : Differentiable ℝ U := hU.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hmono : (α : ℝ) * ‖xref - p‖ ^ 2 ≤
      inner ℝ (gradient U xref) (xref - p) := by
    simpa only [hp, sub_zero] using
      (StrongConvexFirstOrder.gradient_inner_lower_bound_of_strongConvexOn
        hsc (fun z _ => (hd z).hasGradientAt)
        (x := p) (y := xref) (Set.mem_univ _) (Set.mem_univ _))
  have hr : (α : ℝ) * ‖xref - p‖ ≤ ‖gradient U xref‖ := by
    by_cases hz : ‖xref - p‖ = 0
    · simp [hz]
    · have hposr : 0 < ‖xref - p‖ :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hz)
      have hi := (hmono.trans (real_inner_le_norm (gradient U xref) (xref - p)))
      have hm : ((α : ℝ) * ‖xref - p‖) * ‖xref - p‖ ≤
          ‖gradient U xref‖ * ‖xref - p‖ := by nlinarith [hi]
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hm hposr
  have hsq : ((α : ℝ) * ‖xref - p‖) ^ 2 ≤
      ‖gradient U xref‖ ^ 2 :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ (by positivity) (norm_nonneg _)).2 hr
  have hrefDist : ‖xref - p‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) / (α : ℝ) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ ha).2
    have hm : (α : ℝ) * ((α : ℝ) * ‖xref - p‖ ^ 2) ≤
        (α : ℝ) * (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) := by nlinarith [hsq, href]
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left (by nlinarith [hm]) ha
  have hpoint (x : E) : ‖xref - x‖ ^ 2 ≤
      2 * ‖x - p‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖xref - p‖ ^ 2 := by
    have ht : ‖xref - x‖ ≤ ‖xref - p‖ + ‖x - p‖ := by
      calc
        ‖xref - x‖ = ‖(xref - p) + (p - x)‖ := by congr 1; abel
        _ ≤ ‖xref - p‖ + ‖p - x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = _ := by rw [norm_sub_rev p x]
    have htsq : ‖xref - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖xref - p‖ + ‖x - p‖) ^ 2 :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).2 ht
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖xref - p‖ - ‖x - p‖)]
  have hsum : Integrable
      (fun x : E => 2 * ‖x - p‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖xref - p‖ ^ 2) μ :=
    (hpos.const_mul 2).add (integrable_const _)
  have hrefI : Integrable (fun x : E => ‖xref - x‖ ^ 2) μ := by
    apply hsum.mono' (by fun_prop)
    filter_upwards with x
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (‖xref - x‖))] using hpoint x
  have hbase : (∫ x : E, ‖xref - x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤
      4 * ((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) / (α : ℝ)) := by
    have hi := integral_mono hrefI hsum hpoint
    have hs : (∫ x : E,
        2 * ‖x - p‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖xref - p‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) =
        2 * (∫ x : E, ‖x - p‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) + 2 * ‖xref - p‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [integral_add (hpos.const_mul _) (integrable_const _),
        integral_const_mul, integral_const]
      simp
    rw [hs] at hi
    linarith
  have hbaseI : Integrable (fun x : E => ‖x - xref‖ ^ 2) μ := by
    simpa only [norm_sub_rev] using hrefI
  have hsm := PhaseReferenceMoment.gaussianSmoothing_position_second_moment
    μ xref (Real.sqrt η) hbaseI
  change Integrable (fun y : E => ‖y - xref‖ ^ 2) πη ∧
    (∫ y : E, ‖y - xref‖ ^ 2 ∂πη) =
      (∫ x : E, ‖x - xref‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) +
        (Real.sqrt η) ^ 2 * (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) at hsm
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure πη := by
    dsimp [πη, gaussianSmoothing,
      AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.CommonNoiseContraction.addNoise]
    exact Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map
      (by fun_prop : AEMeasurable (fun z : E × E => z.1 + z.2)
        (μ.prod (scaledStdGaussian (E := E) (Real.sqrt η))))
  have hcost := InitialPhaseTransport.phaseWassersteinSq_initial_le_position_moment
    πη xref hκ (by simpa only [norm_sub_rev] using hsm.1)
  have hnum : (∫ y : E, ‖xref - y‖ ^ 2 ∂πη) ≤
      5 * (1 / (α : ℝ)) * (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) := by
    have hb : (∫ x : E, ‖x - xref‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤
        4 * ((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) / (α : ℝ)) := by
      simpa only [norm_sub_rev] using hbase
    have hetaκ : (η : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (α : ℝ) := le_trans hη hκ
    have hh := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hetaκ) hdim
    rw [show (∫ y : E, ‖xref - y‖ ^ 2 ∂πη) =
      (∫ y : E, ‖y - xref‖ ^ 2 ∂πη) by simp only [norm_sub_rev], hsm.2,
      Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ η by exact_mod_cast η.property)]
    rw [div_eq_mul_one_div] at hb
    nlinarith [hb, hh]
  exact hcost.trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hnum)

end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.SmoothedPicardHMC.InitialGibbsPhaseTransport

sources.scope: ASTIS expands the numerical second-moment calculation and keeps the critical-point witness explicit.

assumptions: E is a finite-dimensional complete real inner-product Borel space.
The genuine C2 Hessian of U lies between alpha I and I, with 0 < alpha <= 1 and kappa = 1/alpha.
A point p satisfies gradient U(p) = 0; xref satisfies squared gradient norm at most alpha times dimension.
The Gaussian smoothing variance eta lies in [0,1].
lesson.statement: For the normalized Gibbs law of U, smooth the position by an independent Gaussian of variance eta and adjoin independent standard-Gaussian momentum. The squared transport cost from the initial Dirac-position/Gaussian-momentum law to this actual phase reference is at most five times kappa times dimension.

steps.title: Control the reference-point displacement
steps.text: Strong convexity compares the gradient at xref with its zero value at p. Cauchy-Schwarz and the source's small-gradient condition then bound the distance to p.
steps.formula: \alpha\|x_{\rm ref}-p\|^2\le\langle\nabla U(x_{\rm ref}),x_{\rm ref}-p\rangle\le\|\nabla U(x_{\rm ref})\|\,\|x_{\rm ref}-p\|,\quad\|x_{\rm ref}-p\|^2\le d/\alpha.
steps.lean: HessianStrongConvexity and StrongConvexFirstOrder supply genuine strong monotonicity; positivity permits cancellation.

steps.title: Integrate the Gibbs position moment
steps.text: The already proved normalized Gibbs moment about p is finite and at most d/alpha. The squared triangle inequality makes the moment about xref integrable and bounds it by 4d/alpha.
steps.lean: GibbsPositionMoment.gibbs_position_moment provides the probability law, integrability and sharp center moment; integral_mono applies only after the shifted moment is shown integrable.

steps.title: Add Gaussian smoothing
steps.text: Independent centered Gaussian noise contributes exactly eta times dimension to the position second moment. This is an identity, not an unverified limit exchange.
steps.formula: \mathbb E\|X+\sqrt\eta G-x_{\rm ref}\|^2=\mathbb E\|X-x_{\rm ref}\|^2+\eta d\le(4\kappa+\eta)d.
steps.lean: PhaseReferenceMoment.gaussianSmoothing_position_second_moment proves product measurability, cross-term cancellation and integrability.

steps.title: Couple the momenta identically
steps.text: The initial and reference phase laws share standard-Gaussian momentum. The compiled coupling estimate bounds their squared M-kappa cost by the smoothed position moment; eta <= 1 <= kappa yields 5 kappa d.
steps.lean: InitialPhaseTransport.phaseWassersteinSq_initial_le_position_moment supplies the actual coupling and its cost.

lesson.lean_statement: The Lean conclusion is a squared extended-nonnegative Kantorovich value, not yet a full q>=2 Wasserstein bound. A supplied critical point is a proof-interface assumption that still needs an existence theorem for source-level closure.
lesson.lean_proof: The proof reuses three compiled mathematical parents, derives the reference distance from the genuine Hessian bound, proves shifted-square integrability before monotone integration, and specializes the smoothing scale to sqrt eta.
